scope: Synthetic DSM reconstruction through the same traceBuildingV2 caller and settings for both versions. Not the address-selection, georeferencing, browser or PDF-export pipeline.
falseCompleteNote: Not evaluated: this benchmark generates no PDFs and does not execute the actual export gate. No claim of zero false COMPLETE exports.
accuracyNote: Ground truth is analytic synthetic geometry. These results cannot establish real-property numerical accuracy. Numerical within-threshold counts include automatic estimates and are not measurement acceptance or export passes; unresolved measurements remain unresolved. Skips/errors/unscored values never count as passes.
splitDesign: Existing development seeds 1-120 and a separately frozen synthetic holdout 1100001-1100120. Seed ranges are disjoint. The same parametric generator produces both cohorts.
coverageNote: Generator combines hip/gable rectangular wings, mixed pitches, eave levels, dormers, rotated roofs, DSM noise/blur and clutter. Arbitrary diagonal additions, parcel/address selection, alternate imagery registration and real property evidence require separate fixtures or real runs.
